product_one_liner.value: Envoy is a workplace-management platform for organizations managing physical workplaces, unifying visitor management, emergency response, space reservations, digital signage, and deliveries.

eng_blog.notes: Two engineer-authored technical posts: Shraddha Chadha, Engineering Manager, on the AI threat-detection pipeline (2026-08-10), and Matthew Ellwood, Member of Technical Staff, on rendering React inside Ember (2026-07-16).

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The readable board lists 20 openings, with no qualifying AI, ML, or data-science title. Senior Data Analyst, Marketing does not qualify under the requested definition.

model_provider.notes: The AI terms name both providers; the subprocessor list also names Anthropic for product AI processing. Specific model versions are not identified by these sources.

compliance_certs.notes: The Trust Center lists SOC 2 Type 2, ISO/IEC 27001, HIPAA, and GDPR. HIPAA and GDPR are compliance claims rather than standalone certifications; the center provides SOC 2, ISO 27001, and HIPAA reports/certificate documentation.

last_funding.notes: Announcement date: 2022-01-11; latest publicly disclosed round located. The month reflects the company announcement, not a financing-database closing date.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest disclosed round was announced 2022-01-11, before the 2025-05-09–2026-11-09 window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Live EMEA Outbound BDR posting; the board also lists SMB and Mid Market Account Executive roles.

launched_6mo.notes: Envoy Response launched on 2026-08-06, combining AI-analyzed threat intelligence and incident management; the 2026-09-01 product-release recap also describes its launch.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Envoy announced Mauricio Ramirez as Chief Revenue Officer on 2026-02-26, within the 2025-11-09–2026-11-09 window.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The BDR posting identifies these as tools in Envoy’s tech stack and explicitly calls Salesforce/SFDC, Outreach, ZoomInfo, and Nooks its current stack.
